# ManagedBotUpdated

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.ManagedBotUpdated`

    *,

## Documentation

A bot managed by the current bot was created or updated.

The current bot can get the token of the managed bot with [`get_managed_bot_token`](../../methods/bots/get_managed_bot_token.md).

### Parameters

- **`user`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md))
  The user who created the bot and owns it.

- **`bot`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md))
  The managed bot.
